paragraphs.text: In the adverse event summary table, percentages will be presented with 0 decimals, and a count of zero will be displayed together with its percentage.
The efficacy-evaluable set will consist of all subjects in the safety set who have a baseline value and at least one post-baseline value of the vital sign WEIGHT.
The treatment end date will be the latest end date found among all exposure records.
In the adverse event summary table, percentages will be presented with 2 decimals, and a count of zero will be displayed together with its percentage.
The period of treatment emergence will run until 30 days after the treatment end date, with that last day included.
